title: Affine space morphisms are acyclic for quasi-coherent module direct image
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $a:V\to W$ be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], meaning that $a$ is representable and its base change by every scheme mapping to $W$ is affine. Let $M$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_V$-module on the small etale ringed site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Use module direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] in the categories of all structure-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and compute its right derived functors by injective resolutions in these module categories [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then $R^qa_*M=0$ as an $\mathcal O_W$-module for every integer $q>0$. No Noetherian, properness, finite-type or coherence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 073H (lemma-affine-vanishing-higher-direct-images), module interpretation; the underlying additive comparison is sites-cohomology.tex Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), applied on localized sites.

proof.text: Choose the small sites in a common sheaf universe. On each of $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ and $W_{\mathrm{et}}$, modules over the structure sheaf form a Grothendieck abelian category by the arbitrary-ring-sheaf theorem, hence have enough injectives. Choose an injective module resolution $0\to M\to I^0\to I^1\to\cdots$. The forgetful functor to abelian sheaves is exact, so $0\to M_{\mathrm{ab}}\to I^0_{\mathrm{ab}}\to I^1_{\mathrm{ab}}\to\cdots$ is an exact resolution. The abelian sheaf categories also have enough injectives. No assertion that $I^n_{\mathrm{ab}}$ is injective is made.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), proof: exact forgetting and a module injective resolution; injectives.tex Tag 079Q (remark-existence-D)

proof.text: For an etale scheme $T\to W$, put $U_T=V\times_WT$. Representability of $a$ makes $U_T$ a scheme; etale base change makes $U_T\to V$ an object of $V_{\mathrm{et}}$. Base change on objects and arrows therefore gives the continuous functor $u:W_{\mathrm{et}}\to V_{\mathrm{et}}$, $T\mapsto U_T$, presenting the small-etale morphism. For every module $N$, the chart-limit comparison identifies the specified module direct image with ringed direct image, so $(a_*N)(T)=N(U_T)$ with scalars restricted through $\mathcal O_W(T)\to\mathcal O_V(U_T)$. Thus forgetting gives the identity of complexes $(a_*I^\bullet)_{\mathrm{ab}}=a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}(I^\bullet_{\mathrm{ab}})$, since the equality holds on sections, restrictions, and differentials.

Fix $n\geq0$ and $r>0$. Injectivity of $I^n$ as a structure-module sheaf implies $H^r(U,I^n_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for every object $U$ of $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, by the ringed-site injective-module abelian-acyclicity statement. In particular it is zero at each $U_T$. Apply the general site higher-direct-image formula to $a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}$ presented by $u$: $R^r a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}(I^n_{\mathrm{ab}})$ is the sheafification of $T\mapsto H^r(U_T,I^n_{\mathrm{ab}})$. This is the zero presheaf, whose sheafification is zero. Thus every term $I^n_{\mathrm{ab}}$ is $a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}$-acyclic.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), proof giving objectwise abelian acyclicity; Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images)

proof.text: The resolution from step 1 is concentrated in nonnegative degrees, exact after augmentation, and termwise $a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}$-acyclic by step 3. Apply clause (2) of the acyclic-resolution criterion to the left exact additive direct image between the abelian sheaf categories. It gives $H^q(a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}I^\bullet_{\mathrm{ab}})\cong R^q a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}M_{\mathrm{ab}}$ for every $q\geq0$. In the module category, by the stipulated injective-resolution definition, $R^q a_*M=H^q(a_*I^\bullet)$. Exactness of forgetting and its compatibility with complex cohomology identify the underlying abelian sheaf of this module with $H^q((a_*I^\bullet)_{\mathrm{ab}})$. Substituting the sectionwise identity of step 2 therefore identifies it with $R^q a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}M_{\mathrm{ab}}$. This uses acyclicity, not preservation of injectives by forgetting.

Apply the existing additive affine-space vanishing theorem to $a:V\to W$ and $M$. Its hypotheses are precisely that $a$ is representable with affine scheme base changes and that $M$ is quasi-coherent on the small etale ringed site. It yields $R^q a_{*,\mathrm{Ab}}M_{\mathrm{ab}}=0$ for every $q>0$. Step 4 consequently makes the underlying abelian sheaf of $R^q a_*M$ zero. Faithfulness of forgetting implies that the identity of $R^q a_*M$ equals its zero endomorphism, since their underlying abelian maps agree. Hence $R^q a_*M=0$ as a module sheaf. None of the cited comparison inputs assumes Noetherianity, properness, finite type, coherence, or flatness of the structural map.
